title: DKTV detector sidecar
description: One entry per canonical rule id (skills/*.skill.md registry). Declares HOW each rule is proven: by a deterministic detector, by model judgment (closed question), or not at all (declared, never deleted). Enforced by scripts/validate-detectors.mjs — that script is the source of truth; this file documents the shape.

type.description: detector = a deterministic tool proves the violation; juicio = a model decides applicability AND violation; fuera = not detectable and not judgeable — declared, never deleted.

query.description: Concrete pattern / scan / check. Only meaningful when type=detector.

confidence.description: Expected precision of the detector on this rule (pre-registration; to be validated by the Fase 2 human-adjudicated sample with IC before any number is published).
